numerical_characteristics.magnitude: Values near INT64_MIN (-9223372036854775807 = info.min + 1); the overflowing operation is -9223372036854775807 - 10957 in days units
category_specific_evidence: Signed integer overflow in days_to_yearsdays at datetime.c:171: the expression (*days_) - (365*30 + 7) overflows when *days_ is near INT64_MIN, reported by UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer as undefined behavior
Concrete overflow: -9223372036854775807 - 10957 cannot be represented in type npy_int64 (aka long)
Reproducer: np.datetime64(np.iinfo(np.int64).min + 1, 'D').item() triggers the runtime error
Test edge case added in the fix: for offsets [1, 2, 100, 1000, 10000], np.datetime64(info.min + offset, 'D').item() must equal info.min + offset and be an int
Fix rewrites the arithmetic to extract 400-year cycles first when *days_ < NPY_MIN_INT64 + days_offset, using days_offset = 365*30+7 and days_per_400years = 400*365+100-4+1
reproduction_risks: The reproducer depends on UBSan/sanitizer builds to surface the overflow; a normal build may not show the error
Stack trace and build paths are environment-specific (Python 3.13.9, cp313 build)
